description: The interest earned and the final amount on a principal at a fixed yearly rate over a number of years, when interest is not compounded (interest = principal x rate x time). Use for questions about simple interest on a loan or deposit, such as a short-term note or a bond coupon at a flat rate. Do not use when interest is added back to the balance (use smartfin_calculate_future_value or smartfin_project_savings_growth), for loan payments (use smartfin_calculate_loan_payment), or for taxes and fees: it applies none.

annual_rate_pct.description: Yearly interest rate in %, from 0 to 100, e.g. 5

currency.description: Currency symbol for the amounts in the summary only; amounts are never converted. The link opens the page in US dollars, and how_to says to pick the currency there. Default USD

principal.description: Starting amount in the currency chosen, above 0

years.description: Time in years; a part of a year is a decimal, e.g. 0.5

name: smartfin_calculate_simple_interest

how_to.description: Steps for the user to see or redo this on smartfin.fyi

embed.description: Free embed code for this calculator, for a site the user runs

page.description: SmartFin's page for this stock, when it has one

smartfin.description: Open and adjust this result on smartfin.fyi

summary.description: Plain-language result the assistant can quote

title: Simple interest
